# Meghalaya Government Portal

> > Official government portal for Meghalaya state providing investment services, legislation, departmental information, and administrative resources for citizens and businesses.

The portal serves as the digital gateway to Meghalaya's government services, featuring the MIPA investment platform with UNNATI scheme incentives, comprehensive legal repositories, and information on state departments spanning IT & Communication, Forests & Environment, Social Welfare, and more. The site covers administrative regions including Shillong, Garo Hills, Khasi Hills, Jaintia Hills, and Ri Bhoi.

## Key Topics

- Meghalaya Government
- MIPA (Meghalaya Investment Promotion Agency)
- UNNATI Scheme
- Investment & Business Registration
- State Legislation & Acts
- Government Circulars & Orders
- Shillong
- Garo Hills & Khasi Hills
- Law Department
- IT & Communication Department
- Personnel & Administrative Reforms
- Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs
- Forest Management & Environment
- Industrial Incentives
- Digital Governance

## Investment & Business Services

- [MIPA - Meghalaya Investment Portal](https://invest.meghalaya.gov.in/): Investment portal for Meghalaya featuring UNNATI scheme & business services

## Government Departments

- [IT & Communication Department](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/dept/26): IT & Communication Department driving digital governance in Meghalaya
- [Home (Political) Department](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/dept/33): Home (Political) Department overseeing law, order & internal security
- [Forests & Environment Department](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/dept/17): Forests & Environment Department overview with forest management policies
- [Personnel & AR Department](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/dept/31): Personnel & AR Department managing IAS, MCS civil service administration
- [Social Welfare Department](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/dept/42): Social Welfare Department for women, children, disability & tribal affairs
- [Home (Passport) Department](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/dept/22): Home (Passport) Department handling passport, visa & citizenship services

## State Legislation & Acts

- [Acts Repository](https://meghalaya.gov.in/acts): Repository of Meghalaya state legislation and government acts
- [2024 Building Amendment Byelaws](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/acts/content/46555): 2024 Meghalaya Building Amendment Byelaws from Urban Affairs Department
- [2018 Acts & Ordinances](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/acts/content/37343): 2018 government acts and ordinances from Law Department
- [2014 Legislation](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/acts/content/37339): 2014 ordinances and legislation from Law Department

## Government Circulars & Orders

- [NPS Pension Funds Circular](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/circulars/content/49846): Finance Department circular on NPS pension funds for state employees
- [Tender Committee Order](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/circulars/content/49829): Personnel & AR Department order on tender committee and purchase board
- [District Holiday Circular](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/circulars/content/49285): Local holiday circular for East Khasi Hills District bank closure

## Government Leadership

- [Minister Sosthenes Sohtun](https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/council-of-ministers/49348): Profile of Minister Sosthenes Sohtun, NPP, Jirang constituency
